GRAND GROUP CORPORATION: Pioneering Chemical Excellence in Ningbo, China

Established in the heart of Ningbo, China, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION has been a driving force in the chemical industry for over two decades. Nestled in the vibrant commercial hub of Pacific Plaza, our state-of-the-art facilities at 555 Jingjia Road have become a beacon of innovation and excellence, serving clients across a diverse range of sectors.

As a leading chemical company, we take pride in our unwavering commitment to quality, safety, and environmental sustainability. Our team of highly skilled scientists, engineers, and production specialists work tirelessly to develop cutting-edge products and solutions that cater to the evolving needs of our global clientele.

From the manufacturing of specialized industrial chemicals to the formulation of innovative consumer products, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION has consistently pushed the boundaries of what is possible in the chemical domain. Our extensive research and development efforts, coupled with state-of-the-art technological capabilities, have enabled us to stay at the forefront of industry trends, anticipating and addressing the challenges of tomorrow.

Headquartered in the vibrant city of Ningbo, Zhejiang, China, we leverage our strategic location and robust logistics network to deliver our products and services with unparalleled efficiency and reliability. As we continue to expand our global reach, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION remains steadfast in its mission to be the trusted partner of choice for chemical solutions that power progress and drive prosperity.
